programme.desc: Three contestants compete on arrow-word grids that they try to fill in by finding the answers to the given clues. But to access the clues, they must first answer questions with a very particular characteristic: the answer is always a letter.

programme.title: Le Telejournal De Radio-Canada
programme.desc: The televised news programme from the Radio-Canada team.

programme.title: LE TÉLÉJOURNAL DE RADIO-CANADA
programme.desc: Le Téléjournal de Radio-Canada menyajikan liputan berita nasional dan internasional secara menyeluruh dengan laporan mendalam dan pembaruan terkini.

programme.title: La Belle Vie
programme.desc: After visiting Julien's base camp, we head back on the road to adventure with a trip to meet Serge Beaudette, a nature-lover who has now spent over seven years living off-grid in his tiny house in the shape of a tepee.

programme.title: LA BELLE VIE
programme.desc: LA BELLE VIE mengeksplorasi destinasi menarik, pengalaman berkesan, kuliner lezat, dan tokoh inspiratif yang membuktikan bahwa kebahagiaan dapat ditemukan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

programme.title: Chroniques Mediterraneennes Nature
programme.desc: On the edge of the Ecrins National Park lies the Land of La Meije. A paradise for mountaineers and lovers of high mountains, it is also an unspoilt natural haven where people maintain a special relationship with the environment.

programme.title: CHRONIQUES MÉDITERRANÉENNES NATURE
programme.desc: CHRONIQUES MÉDITERRANÉENNES NATURE mengungkap keanekaragaman hayati, bentang alam, dan upaya pelestarian di kawasan Mediterania melalui gambar-gambar alam yang memukau.

programme.title: Gigantosaurus
programme.desc: Four little dinosaurs, Rocky, Bill, Tiny and Mazu, discover a dangerous world where the mysterious Gigantosaurus, the most ferocious of all the dinosaurs, is forever on the prowl. The four best friends set their heading for adventure, confronting their fears and working together to solve all their problems.

programme.title: Gigantosaurus
programme.desc: Rocky, Bill, Tiny dan Mazu adalah empat dinosaurus muda yang tumbuh pada periode Cretaceous. Mereka sekawanan dinosaurus yang selalu mencari petualangan baru di setiap tempat yang mereka kunjungi. Gunung berapi baru bermunculan setiap saat, brachiosaurus berleher panjang dan triceratops raksasa berkeliaran bebas, hujan meteor menerangi langit malam dan Gigantosaurus yang ganas menguasai semuanya. Bisakah mereka berteman dengan Giganto, sang Raja Dinosaurus.

programme.title: L'Afrik En Contes
programme.desc: In a village lives a very beautiful girl, so beautiful that people come from far and wide just to see her. Unfortunately the village has no more water. To break the curse, the young girl must be sacrificed.

programme.title: L'AFRIK EN CONTES
programme.desc: L'AFRIK EN CONTES menghidupkan kembali dongeng tradisional Afrika melalui animasi penuh warna dan penceritaan yang menarik. Setiap episode menyampaikan pesan moral, humor, dan warisan budaya, memperkenalkan penonton muda pada tokoh-tokoh legendaris serta kebijaksanaan turun-temurun.

programme.title: API !
programme.desc: Api ! mengisahkan keseharian Api, seorang siswi cerdas dan bertanggung jawab, bersama teman-temannya di lingkungan sekolah dasar. Setiap episode menghadirkan cerita tentang persahabatan, tantangan belajar, konflik kecil, hingga petualangan yang membantu mereka tumbuh menjadi pribadi yang lebih baik. Melalui berbagai situasi yang dekat dengan kehidupan anak-anak, serial ini mengajarkan nilai-nilai penting seperti kejujuran, rasa tanggung jawab, empati, dan kerja sama. Dengan pendekatan yang ringan dan menghibur, Api ! menjadi tontonan edukatif yang membantu anak-anak memahami dunia sosial di sekitar mereka.

programme.title: Les Quiquoi
programme.desc: Olive, Petole, Boulard, Mixo, Raoul and Pamela make up a full-of-fun gang known as the Quiquoi. Together they ask a host of existential questions, using drawings to find the answers. In their own quirky way, they love nothing better than creating surrealist worlds where everything becomes possible.

programme.title: ROCKY & LILY : C'EST DANS LA BOÎTE !
programme.desc: Rocky & Lily : C’est dans la Boîte ! mengajak anak-anak berimajinasi melalui petualangan kreatif yang lahir dari benda sehari-hari.

programme.title: Rocky & Lily : C'Est Dans La Boite !
programme.desc: Every day, Rocky and Lily receive a new box on the set. But what does it contain? It's always a surprising object that leads them to discover very different subjects: turtles, bowling or even cloud formation.

programme.title: DRAZILION
programme.desc: Drazilion mengisahkan petualangan Oli, Emma, Fabio, dan Rachel yang menjelajahi dunia fantasi bernama Virmark. Berbekal rasa ingin tahu dan semangat petualangan, mereka berusaha menemukan Drazilion, makhluk legendaris yang diyakini sebagai induk dari seluruh makhluk yang hidup di dunia tersebut. Sepanjang perjalanan, mereka bertemu berbagai spesies unik, menghadapi tantangan yang tidak terduga, serta memecahkan masalah bersama. Setiap petualangan mengajarkan nilai-nilai penting seperti keberanian, persahabatan, kerja sama, dan kepedulian terhadap lingkungan. Dengan perpaduan fantasi, humor, dan aksi yang ringan, serial animasi ini menghadirkan pengalaman yang menghibur sekaligus edukatif bagi anak-anak.

programme.title: Drazilion
programme.desc: Emma Lafreniere, Eliot Perron, Leo Mai, Gabrielle B. Thuot, Normand Brathwaite

programme.title: TOUT LE MONDE VEUT PRENDRE SA PLACE
programme.desc: Tout le Monde Veut Prendre sa Place adalah kuis populer di mana peserta menantang juara bertahan untuk merebut posisi teratas.

programme.title: Tout Le Monde Veut Prendre Sa Place
programme.desc: The game where everyone wants to be a winner. One quiz, six candidates and, comfortably installed in his chair, one champion... whom everyone dreams of unseating!

programme.title: LE CLAIR DE TERRE
programme.desc: Le Clair de Terre mengisahkan Pierre Brumeu, seorang pemuda yang menjalani kehidupan monoton di Paris bersama ayahnya sambil terus dibayangi kenangan akan ibunya yang telah meninggal sejak lama. Merasa kehilangan arah dan keterikatan dengan masa lalunya, Pierre memutuskan kembali ke Tunisia, tempat ia dilahirkan dan menghabiskan masa kecilnya. Dalam perjalanan tersebut, ia berusaha menemukan kembali potongan-potongan kenangan yang nyaris terlupakan, bertemu orang-orang yang pernah mengenal keluarganya, serta menghadapi pertanyaan tentang identitas dan asal-usulnya. Dengan gaya yang puitis dan melankolis, film ini menjadi refleksi mendalam tentang kehilangan, nostalgia, pengasingan, dan pencarian tempat seseorang di dunia.

programme.title: Un Bon Garcon
programme.desc: Igor Van Dessel, Sandrine Blancke, Steve Driesen

programme.title: UN BON GARÇON

programme.title: Alterrenative Voyages
programme.desc: We head for the Antarctic aboard the high polar expedition vessel operated by Ponant, "Le Commandant Charcot". We notably meet the chief engineer, Hugues Decamus, and the captain, Stanislas Devorsine.

programme.title: ALTERRENATIVE VOYAGES
programme.desc: Dokumenter perjalanan yang menampilkan cara unik dan berkelanjutan dalam menjelajahi destinasi, dengan fokus pada budaya, lingkungan, dan hubungan manusia yang autentik.

programme.title: HEUREUSEMENT QU'ON S'A
programme.desc: Vincent, remaja berusia 13 tahun, sangat mengagumi ayahnya yang gemar sepak bola dan bercita-cita menjadi pelatih profesional. Namun di balik sosok yang ia kagumi, sang ayah ternyata mengabaikan keluarga dan menyerahkan seluruh beban rumah tangga kepada istrinya. Ketika sang ibu mengalami kelelahan mental hingga mencoba mengakhiri hidupnya dan kemudian dirawat karena depresi, Vincent bersama adik laki-laki dan adik perempuannya berharap mendapatkan dukungan dari ayah mereka. Sayangnya, ayah mereka justru menolak mengambil tanggung jawab. Terpaksa menjadi tulang punggung keluarga di usia yang masih sangat muda, Vincent harus menjaga kedua adiknya sekaligus menghadapi kenyataan pahit tentang sosok ayah yang selama ini ia idolakan. Di tengah berbagai kesulitan, ketiga bersaudara itu menemukan kekuatan melalui kasih sayang dan solidaritas satu sama lain.

programme.title: DÉTERRE
programme.desc: Dari ruang arsip, jurnalis Aurélie Cuttat menelusuri berbagai dokumen, foto, rekaman, dan kesaksian untuk menghidupkan kembali kisah-kisah yang hampir terlupakan dalam sejarah Swiss. Setiap episode mengangkat peristiwa unik, tokoh inspiratif, serta momen penting yang pernah membentuk kehidupan sosial dan budaya masyarakat Swiss. Dengan pendekatan investigatif dan historis, program ini mengajak penonton melihat kembali masa lalu dari sudut pandang yang segar dan menarik.

programme.title: Legend Of Kitchen Soldier, Ep 7
programme.desc: Kang Seong Jae adalah seorang prajurit yang dipindahkan ke Pos Gangrim, tempat Sersan Mayor Park Jae Yeong, Letnan Satu Cho Ye Rin, dan juru masak militer Yun Dong Hyeon bertugas.

programme.title: Legend Of Kitchen Soldier, Ep 8
programme.desc: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier mengisahkan Kang Seong-jae, seorang pemuda dari keluarga sederhana yang memutuskan masuk militer setelah kematian ayahnya. Meski menjadi lulusan terbaik selama pelatihan, ia justru ditempatkan di bagian dapur karena pengalamannya membantu usaha food truck milik sang ayah. Kehidupannya berubah ketika sebuah sistem misterius layaknya permainan video muncul dan memberinya berbagai misi memasak. Setiap tantangan yang berhasil diselesaikan membuat kemampuan memasaknya berkembang pesat hingga ia menjadi sosok yang dihormati oleh rekan-rekan dan atasannya. Di balik kisah penuh humor dan semangat kebersamaan di barak militer, Seong-jae juga perlahan menemukan petunjuk tentang rahasia yang mungkin berkaitan dengan kematian ayahnya. Serial ini memadukan komedi, fantasi, dunia kuliner, dan kisah pertumbuhan diri dalam sebuah petualangan yang menghibur dan hangat.

programme.title: Fresh Off The Sea S3, Ep 2
programme.desc: Para anggota mengunjungi destinasi pesisir baru untuk merasakan kehidupan masyarakat setempat. Mereka mengumpulkan hasil laut dan bahan pangan musiman, kemudian mengolahnya menjadi hidangan lezat sambil menghadapi berbagai tantangan sehari-hari. Kerja sama, canda, dan kebersamaan di tengah suasana alam yang indah menghadirkan pengalaman yang hangat sekaligus menghibur.

programme.title: Mr. Eo's Food World Tour, Ep 6
programme.desc: Mr. Eo dan timnya menjelajah ke tempat-tempat yang belum dikenal untuk mencari resep baru, sambil menciptakan hidangan-hidangan yang unik sepanjang perjalanan.

programme.title: Mr. Eo's Food World Tour, Ep 7
programme.desc: Mr. Eo dan timnya menjelajah ke tempat-tempat yang belum dikenal untuk mencari resep baru, sambil menciptakan hidangan-hidangan yang unik sepanjang perjalanan.

programme.title: Space Rice Cake, Ep 2
programme.desc: Para peserta kembali menjalani serangkaian misi bertema luar angkasa yang menguji kreativitas, kekompakan, dan kemampuan mereka beradaptasi dengan berbagai situasi tak terduga. Di tengah persaingan yang semakin seru, mereka harus bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan setiap tantangan sambil menghadirkan berbagai aksi lucu dan spontan. programme.desc: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier mengisahkan Kang Seong-jae, seorang pemuda dari keluarga sederhana yang memutuskan masuk militer setelah kematian ayahnya. Meski menjadi lulusan terbaik selama pelatihan, ia justru ditempatkan di bagian dapur karena pengalamannya membantu usaha food truck milik sang ayah. Kehidupannya berubah ketika sebuah sistem misterius layaknya permainan video muncul dan memberinya berbagai misi memasak. Setiap tantangan yang berhasil diselesaikan membuat kemampuan memasaknya berkembang pesat hingga ia menjadi sosok yang dihormati oleh rekan-rekan dan atasannya. Di balik kisah penuh humor dan semangat kebersamaan di barak militer, Seong-jae juga perlahan menemukan petunjuk tentang rahasia yang mungkin berkaitan dengan kematian ayahnya. Serial ini memadukan komedi, fantasi, dunia kuliner, dan kisah pertumbuhan diri dalam sebuah petualangan yang menghibur dan hangat.

programme.desc: Doo Hyeon yang dikenal dengan nama "Goblin" masuk penjara karena jatuh cinta pada Yeong Min yang membunuh bosnya. Setelah 10 tahun, Doo Hyeon dibebaskan dan telah menjalani kehidupan normal. Namun, dia harus menerima kenyataan bahwa Yeong Min telah memanfaatkan namanya "Goblin". Yeong Min bahkan menculik putrinya untuk tutup mulut. Doo Hyeon marah, melakukan balas dendam dan mengumumkan kembalinya "Goblin" yang asli.

Akibat kesulitan keuangan dan ibu yang sakit-sakitan, Marco memutuskan pergi ke Korea Selatan untuk mencari keberadaan sang ayah yang sejak kecil meninggalkannya. Setibanya di Korea Selatan, Marco mendadak menjadi buronan seorang pria misterius dan sekelompok orang jahat yang tak pernah berhenti mengejarnya.

programme.title: Dragon Inn: The City Of Sadness
programme.desc: Dragon Inn: The City of Sadness mengisahkan sebuah organisasi vigilante yang beroperasi secara rahasia di balik sebuah restoran bernama Dragon Inn. Kelompok ini menjalankan misinya sendiri untuk menghukum para pelaku kejahatan yang tidak tersentuh hukum. Setiap anggota memiliki masa lalu kelam dan alasan pribadi yang mendorong mereka bergabung. Situasi berubah ketika putra seorang pengusaha terkenal ditemukan tewas dan salah satu anggota Dragon Inn diduga terlibat dalam kasus tersebut. Di tengah penyelidikan, berbagai rahasia, pengkhianatan, dan konflik berdarah mulai terungkap. Para anggota harus berjuang menghadapi musuh dari luar sekaligus mempertahankan kepercayaan satu sama lain dalam dunia yang dipenuhi korupsi dan balas dendam.

programme.title: Cafe Midnight

programme.title: Dragon Inn: Night Of Salvation
programme.desc: Dragon Inn: Night of Salvation melanjutkan kisah organisasi rahasia Dragon Inn yang menjalankan misinya sendiri untuk menghukum para pelaku kejahatan yang lolos dari hukum. Kali ini mereka menerima kasus hilangnya seorang gadis remaja yang tidak memiliki alasan untuk melarikan diri dari rumah. Dalam proses penyelidikan, mereka menemukan keterkaitan antara kasus tersebut dengan sebuah sekte keagamaan yang beroperasi secara mencurigakan. Ketika identitas dan lokasi Dragon Inn terbongkar akibat sebuah kesalahan, para anggota organisasi harus menghadapi ancaman yang semakin besar. Di tengah pertarungan melawan kelompok berbahaya tersebut, mereka berusaha menyelamatkan korban sekaligus mengungkap kebenaran di balik jaringan kejahatan yang tersembunyi. Film ini menghadirkan perpaduan aksi, misteri, dan ketegangan yang lebih intens dibanding pendahulunya.

programme.title: It Came From Outer Space
programme.desc: While looking through his telescope one night, John Putnam (Richard Carlson) sees what at first appears to be a meteor shower -- but it is actually a crash-landing alien spaceship! After investigating the crater from the impact, John informs the town sheriff (Charles Drake), and receives nothing but ridicule. Even his fiancée, Ellen (Barbara Rush), is skeptical. All that changes when the townsfolk start disappearing, and are replaced by eerie alien duplicates.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Curiosity Quest is an upbeat, family, educational program that explores what viewers are curious about. In each show, host Joel Greene ventures on a quest to answer viewer's letters of curiosity.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel as he visits a cranberry bog in Wisconsin to learn how cranberries are harvested. Watch as Joel encounters the cold Wisconsin weather and wades through the flooded cranberry fields to help.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this high intensity quest where he learns from Sensei Mark, how karate is done. Watch as he gets "initiated" and earns his very first black stripe.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this quest as he learns how a basketball court can become an ice hockey floor. Grab your jackets and watch as the transformation occurs at an amazing speed.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this quest as he journeys to Oregon where he joins a boat safety class to learn what to do just in case he needs to abandon ship. Watch as Joel jumps in his safety suit and learns how to board the small raft.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this freezing quest as he learns how snow can be "man-made." Watch this early morning action as he tours the mountain in a snow cat.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this tasty quest as he learns how to make designer cakes. Watch as he eats his way through his lessons and joins a cake maker to create a yummy masterpiece.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this quest as he learns what it takes to become a fire fighter. Watch as he carries a water hose, runs into a burning building, and puts out a fire.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this flavorful quest as he learns how to make pizza from start to finish. Watch as Joel and the CQ crew designs their very own Curiosity Quest pizza and offer it to patrons at John's Incredible Pizza.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this adventurous quest as he learns what it takes to become a rock climber. Watch as he attempts to climb the treacherous walls of Red Rock Climbing Center.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel as learns about the variety of cheeses Wisconsin has to offer. Hold your breath as he makes his way through the only Limburger factory in the U.S, samples the creamy taste of gruyere, and crumbles feta cheese.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel as he hits the wild wild west trails on a horseback adventure. Watch as Joel's nerves hit the peak, as his vibrant horse, Domino, takes him for a gallop.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel as he visits Zingerman's Bakery in Michigan to learn how different types of bread are made. Watch as he helps create black cherry, chocolate bread and brownies at this world famous bakery.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this quest as he learns what it's like to be a cheerleader from the co-ed cheer squad at Brigham Young University. Hold your breath as Joel attempts to safely complete a backflip.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this quest as he journeys through the Moonridge Animal Park in Big Bear, California. Watch as the Curiosity Quest crew gets up close, and personal with deer and experiences a rare, and endangered snow leopard.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how Chuck E Cheese can move his arms and mouth, or how all the characters in the rides at Disneyland can look so real? Host of Curiosity Quest, Joel Greene explores this life-like quest and tours the Garner Holt Productions facility where movie animatronics are made. Get a sneak-peak into all the hard-work that goes into making creatures come to life including the ideas, design, fabrication, molding, and final stages.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Host of Curiosity Quest, Joel Greene explores this tasty quest as he gets an inside look on how oranges are grown, sorted and packaged to be shipped across the world. It is harvest time when Greene arrives and he gets to experience, first hand, how oranges are hand- picked as he struggles to fill his bag with 50 pounds of oranges. Did you know that oranges are sprayed with a wax to make them look prettier?

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this sweet quest to the Mrs. Fields cookie gifting facility in Utah to learn how they make their famous, and delicious cookies. Watch as Joel displays his lack of skill when it comes to the fine art of baking.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this unique quest to learn how plastic and foam plates are made. We've all used and seen these products, now get a behind-the-scenes look at how they are transformed.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join the Curiosity Quest crew on this quest to learn how bowling balls are made. And, not just any bowling balls - but scented bowling balls!

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Host of Curiosity Quest, Joel Greene and the crew travel north to the beautiful state of Alaska and get a front row seat to a stream packed with more salmon than you can imagine. Greene learns from an Alaska Fish and Wildlife specialist why their creeks are bursting with salmon and why they travel thousands of miles to re-visit the place they were born.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Host of Curiosity Quest, Joel Greene gets an all access pass to one of the largest helicopter manufacturers to learn how helicopters are made. Once inside the massive warehouse, Greene learns that building a helicopter begins with the basic raw materials, however these materials must be very light, very precise but at the same time, durable. Each component is shaped, formed, changed, altered - you name it - and becomes a small part of a gigantic puzzle.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: If you have ever eaten store-bought ice cream...well guess what! Then you've most likely eaten kelp! Host of Curiosity Quest, Joel Greene, floats through the Monterey Bay Aquarium to learn all the inner-workings of a busy aquarium. From cleaning the tanks, to feeding the sea birds, to balancing over a massive fish tank and hand-feeding a fish that will make you say "holy moly," this episode is packed with excitement.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Travel with Joel Greene and the Curiosity Quest crew to Alaska for this adventure. Watch as Joel learns about a massive glacier, gets up close to a real black bear, and spots humpback and killer whales off the shore.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how toothpaste can sometimes taste so great? Join Joel Greene as he ventures through the Tom's of Maine facility where they make Silly Strawberry toothpaste.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join in this episode as professional child drummer Cole Marcus, travels through the Vic Firth manufacturing facility to learn how drum sticks are made. Watch as Cole tries to teach Joel drumming tips and technique.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered where mushrooms come from? Join Curiosity Quest host, Joel Greene on this adventure to Monterey Mushrooms to learn how mushrooms are grown, harvested, and packaged for consumers all over the United States. On this DVD, you will learn the important things that mushrooms need in order to grow, including what is needed in the soil, the temperature and moisture in the air, and the ever-important sun.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest

programme.desc: After James, a blind man, inexplicably regains his vision, he becomes possessed by a drive to make a better life for himself. However, his new improvements -- a nicer home, a higher paying job, tailored suits, luxury car -- leave little room for the people who were part of his old, simpler life. As his relationships buckle under the strain of his snowballing ambition, it becomes uncertain if James can ever return from darkness.

programme.title: Derailed
programme.desc: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus.

programme.title: The Crush
programme.desc: Writer Nick Eliot moves to a new city for a magazine job and rents a room in the house of Cliff and Liv Forrester, whose 14-year-old daughter, Adrian, instantly makes her attraction to Nick clear. While Nick romances photographer Amy Maddik at work, he has trouble fending off Adrian's advances. As her obsession with Nick grows, Adrian becomes angry at being rejected and starts attacking his property and friends.

programme.title: Dawg
programme.desc: After a lifetime of wooing, bedding and then leaving women without giving them a second thought, the self-centered Douglas Munford (Denis Leary) finds himself having to reflect on the hurt he has caused -- that is, if he wants a big inheritance from his late grandmother. According to Anna (Elizabeth Hurley), the estate's executor, Douglas must find 12 of the women he mistreated and get their forgiveness. Thus, the man who earned the nickname "Dawg" begins his journey of redemption.

programme.title: Jeffrey
programme.desc: Jeffrey (Steven Weber), a gay man living in New York City with an overwhelming fear of contracting AIDS, concludes that being celibate is the only option to protect himself. As fate would have it, shortly after his declaration of a sex-free existence, he meets the handsome Steve Howard (Michael T. Weiss), his dream man -- except for his HIV-positive status. Facing this dilemma, Jeffrey turns to his best friend (Patrick Stewart) and an outrageous priest (Nathan Lane) for guidance.

programme.title: Lawnmower Man 2: Beyond Cyberspace
programme.desc: Jobe (Matt Frewer) exists as a malevolent consciousness in virtual reality and seeks to discover the technology to hack into all the world's computers. Jobe contacts Peter (Austin O'Brien), who had been a friend during his corporeal existence, to assist him, but the young man realizes Jobe's evil intent. Peter calls on Benjamin (Patrick Bergin), a brilliant computer engineer, to help thwart Jobe's scheme for world domination, and a battle rages throughout cyberspace and in the real world.

programme.title: Until Death
programme.desc: Anthony Stowe (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is a drug-addicted detective teetering on the edge. He shows little regard for his fellow cops, ratting out a respected veteran who takes him to task shortly before he's fired. All Stowe cares about is putting away drug-dealing former cop Callahan (Stephen Rea), who is taking over New Orleans' underworld. But Callahan's henchman (Stephen Lord) puts Stowe in a coma, and after he awakens, he realizes it's more important to redeem himself and get off drugs.

programme.title: Movie Movie
programme.desc: This spoof of 1930s American films features two movies and a trailer, with the same cast members acting in all three. "Dynamite Hands" follows an up-and-coming boxer (Harry Hamlin) with a heart of gold who stumbles into a life of excess when he falls for a nightclub singer (Trish Van Devere) and meets a sleazy gangster (Eli Wallach). In "Baxter's Beauties of 1933," a Broadway producer (George C. Scott) learns that he is dying and attempts to create one last hit show.

programme.title: Before the Devil Knows You're Dead
programme.desc: Andy (Philip Seymour Hoffman), a debt-ridden broker, needs some quick cash. He ropes his younger brother, Hank (Ethan Hawke), into a scheme to commit the perfect crime: to rob their parents' (Albert Finney, Rosemary Harris) jewelry store. The scheme goes horribly awry, and the family patriarch takes justice into his own hands, unaware that the criminals he is hunting are his own sons.

programme.title: Two for the Money
programme.desc: A former college athlete (Matthew McConaughey) joins forces with a sports consultant (Al Pacino) to handicap football games for high-rolling gamblers.

programme.title: Crime Story

programme.title: Fong Sai-Yuk II
programme.desc: Having failed a secret mission for the Red Flower Society, Chinese folk hero Fong Sai Yuk (Jet Li) must try to get his hands on a special document by wooing the governor's daughter, Man-Yin (Amy Kwok). This doesn't sit well with his fiancée, Ting Ting (Michelle Reis), or with his martial arts-master mother (Josephine Hsiao). programme.title: Living in Oblivion
programme.desc: Independent film director Nick Reve is making his first feature. Everything that can go wrong does: the rebellious catering crew refuses to replace spoiled milk, his actors are flaky and getting an unspoiled take is nearly impossible. Tension between lead actress Nicole and actor Chad, who have just slept together, contributes to the many problems on set. As money and time run out, Nick struggles to complete his film.

programme.title: The Company
programme.desc: Loretta "Ry" Ryan (Neve Campbell) is an aspiring ballerina performing with the renowned Joffrey Ballet in Chicago. As she struggles with the demands of being a dancer, she also begins a relationship with the handsome Josh (James Franco), who isn't involved in that insular world. The drama looks at the lives of others in the company, including the passionate artistic director, Alberto Antonelli (Malcolm McDowell), and features many actual Joffrey dancers.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear of Everything
programme.desc: Becoming paranoid after his research into serial killers, a writer (Simon Pegg) must confront his numerous demons in order to make it to an important meeting about his screenplay.

programme.title: Piranha
programme.desc: A government tank containing genetically engineered piranha is unwittingly emptied into a river that flows past a resort area.

programme.title: Timecop
programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: Phoenix
programme.desc: After superstitious cop Harry Collins (Ray Liotta) racks up significant gambling debts, he is given the option of killing an informant. Collins decides to instead rob a loan shark (Giancarlo Esposito) in order to pay off his bookie (Tom Noonan), so he can run off with bartender Leila (Anjelica Huston). He is aided by his rough partner, Mike (Anthony LaPaglia), as well as corrupt officers James (Daniel Baldwin) and Fred (Jeremy Piven), and the robbery quickly becomes more than Harry anticipated.

programme.title: Freejack
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.title: Two Thousand and None
programme.desc: A man finds himself seeing life from a new point when he finds out it's almost over. Before long he starts seeing images of his childhood in Armenia everywhere. His last mission in life is to dig up his parents in Canada and bury them in Armenia, where he believes him and his family belong.

programme.title: Pacific Heights
programme.desc: Unmarried yuppies Patty (Melanie Griffith) and Drake (Matthew Modine) move into an expensive dream home in a high-end neighborhood in San Francisco. As they renovate the house, they look for a tenant for the first floor of their house. Carter Hayes (Michael Keaton) seems like a great fit at first, but it transpires that he is a con artist who plans to swindle them out of their real estate. As Hayes tries to drive them out of their own home, the couple must take drastic measures to fight back.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Blob
programme.desc: A drive-in favorite, this sci-fi classic follows teenagers Steve (Steven McQueen) and his best girl, Jane (Aneta Corseaut), as they try to protect their hometown from a gelatinous alien life form that engulfs everything it touches. The first to discover the substance and live to tell about it, Steve and Jane witness the blob destroying an elderly man and grow to a terrifying size. But no one else has seen the goo, and policeman Dave (Earl Rowe) refuses to believe the kids without proof.

programme.title: The Kentucky Fried Movie
programme.desc: Pop-culture satires include "Cleopatra Schwartz," "A Fistful of Yen" and "Catholic High-School Girls in Trouble."

programme.title: Love Blossoms
programme.desc: Perfumer Violet is desperate to formulate her late father's unfinished signature scent. Under great pressure to finish by Valentine's Day, Violet hires an inexperienced botanist with an uncanny ability to identify scents. It's not long before their professional relationship turns romantic, threatening their deadline and feelings for each other. Stars Shantel VanSanten and Victor Webster.

programme.desc: A mix up on her first day of work sends Shane to the Dead Letter Office, where a group of quirky characters led by Oliver try to deliver the undeliverable. Though Shane wants out of this strange detail, she can't help but get caught up inthe story...

programme.desc: Nell (Diane Ladd) discovers a treasure map that Bree (Emilie Ullerup) made as a teen, leading Bree and Kevin (Brendan Penny) to hunt for a family time capsule in the backyard. While Trace (Jesse Metcalfe) is in Nashville fighting his producer...

programme.desc: Maya Sulliway is a struggling single mom who's studying to become an accountant. programme.desc: When Tess inherits an apple orchard along with a half-sister she never met, she unravels the mystery of the family who abandoned her, ultimately finding a new understanding of herself. Stars Rachelle Lefevre, Niall Matter.

programme.desc: Shortly after celebrating 50 years of marriage, elderly farmer Sam Peek (Hume Cronyn) loses his wife, Cora (Jessica Tandy), to a heart attack. Though overwhelmed with grief, Sam stubbornly insists that he continue to tend to his orchards, refusing to entertain his family's suggestions that he slow down. But when Sam cautiously reveals that he believes Cora has returned in the form of an elusive white dog, his adult children and grandson Bobby (Harley Cross) grow concerned about his sanity.

programme.desc: Big city girls Julia and her best friend Sydney take a trip to a dude ranch in Wyoming for a fun weekend getaway. But when a brawl ensues in the local bar one night, the girls are sentenced to perform community service for disorderly conduct...

But what starts as a serene evening of stargazing quickly turns into a harrowing nightmare when a meteor from the comet transforms Popeye, into a terrifying and unstoppable killing machine.

programme.desc: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.desc: An intimate exploration of a bullied outsider's battle to the top of the UFC, revealing Israel Adesanya's brutal, beautiful struggle to become the global phenomenon known as 'The Last Stylebender.'

programme.desc: In 2014, BuzzFeed writer Matt Stopera's phone was stolen from a bar in New York City. A year later, photos of storefronts and a man next to an orange tree mysteriously appeared in his iPhoto stream. Matt wrote an article about it, and overnight, it went viral in China, where internet users identified the man as "Brother Orange." Matt became an instant celebrity, and as media followed their every move, he and Brother Orange formed a deep friendship that transcended cultural and language barriers.

Together, they embark on a long and dangerous journey with one goal: to defeat Haggard and save the unicorns from extinction.

programme.desc: Young Bruce Lee is trying to make a name for himself while working as a martial arts instructor in 1964 San Francisco. When Lee meets Wong Jack Man, he challenges the kung fu master to a no-holds-barred fight that became the stuff of legend.

programme.title: The Great Wall
programme.desc: When a mercenary warrior (Matt Damon) is imprisoned within the Great Wall, he discovers the mystery behind one of the greatest wonders of the world. As wave after wave of marauding beasts besiege the massive structure, his quest for fortune turns into a journey toward heroism as he joins a huge army of elite warriors to confront the unimaginable and seemingly unstoppable force.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Unleashed
programme.desc: Crime boss Bart raises orphan Danny with no knowledge of anything other than how to fight, using him as an enforcer when debts must be collected. Planning to enter Danny into a fight tournament and retire with the prize money, Bart disappears after a deadly drive-by shooting. Danny flees and takes shelter with piano tuner Sam. Away from Bart's abusive control, Danny learns how to live like a human and begins investigating his past.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: It's been 10 years since Jason Bourne (Matt Damon) walked away from the agency that trained him to become a deadly weapon. Hoping to draw him out of the shadows, CIA director Robert Dewey assigns hacker and counterinsurgency expert Heather Lee to find him. Lee suspects that former operative Nicky Parsons is also looking for him. As she begins tracking the duo, Bourne finds himself back in action battling a sinister network that utilizes terror and technology to maintain unchecked power.

programme.title: Glass
programme.desc: David Dunn tries to stay one step ahead of the law while delivering vigilante justice on the streets of Philadelphia. His special talents soon put him on a collision course with the Beast -- the psychotic madman who has superhuman strength and 23 distinct personalities. Their epic showdown leads them to an encounter with the mysterious Elijah Price, the criminal mastermind who holds critical secrets for both men.

programme.title: Birth of the Dragon
programme.desc: Young Bruce Lee is trying to make a name for himself while working as a martial arts instructor in 1964 San Francisco. When Lee meets Wong Jack Man, he challenges the kung fu master to a no-holds-barred fight that became the stuff of legend.

programme.title: The Great Wall
programme.desc: When a mercenary warrior (Matt Damon) is imprisoned within the Great Wall, he discovers the mystery behind one of the greatest wonders of the world. As wave after wave of marauding beasts besiege the massive structure, his quest for fortune turns into a journey toward heroism as he joins a huge army of elite warriors to confront the unimaginable and seemingly unstoppable force.

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: When their ship crashes on an unexplored planet, the survivors of the crash soon discover that this planet that is normally always day is going to soon be in a state of eclipse that will bring out deadly nocturnal creatures. Will a prison convict (Vin Diesel) being transported on the ship end up being the one man who can lead the survivors off the planet?

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: Caught in a typhoon, a tugboat commanded by Robert Everton (Donald Sutherland) comes across a mysterious near-deserted ship. Excited to find a vessel that could be sold for as much as $30 million, Everton and his crew board and prepare to move the craft, despite the warnings of sole survivor Nadia Vinogradova (Joanna Pacula). When a malevolent alien presence begins killing off the crew, navigator Kit Foster (Jamie Lee Curtis) tries to convince the rest of them to leave before it's too late.

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

programme.title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
programme.desc: Hospital emergency room Dr. Daniel "Dan" Challis (Tom Atkins) and Ellie Grimbridge (Stacey Nelkin), the daughter of a murder victim, uncover a terrible plot by small-town mask maker Conal Cochran (Dan O'Herlihy), a madman who's planning a Halloween mass murder utilizing an ancient Celtic ritual. The ritual involves a boulder stolen from Stonehenge, the use of Silver Shamrock masks and a triggering device contained in a television commercial -- all designed to kill millions of children.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.desc: Former CIA black-ops agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) and his old partner, Marvin Boggs (John Malkovich), are caught in the grip of retirement -- but that soon changes when a powerful Cold War weapon known as Nightshade resurfaces decades after its disappearance. programme.title: Operation Fortune: Ruse de guerre
programme.desc: Elite spy Orson Fortune must track down and stop the sale of a deadly new weapons technology wielded by billionaire arms broker Greg Simmonds. Reluctantly teamed up with some of the world's best operatives, Fortune and his crew recruit Hollywood's biggest movie star, Danny Francesco, to help them on their globe-trotting mission to save the world.

programme.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
programme.desc: Unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, actor Nick Cage accepts a $1 million offer to attend a wealthy fan's birthday party. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when a CIA operative recruits Cage for an unusual mission. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones.

programme.title: The Spy Who Dumped Me
programme.desc: Best friends Audrey and Morgan are going about their humdrum lives in Los Angeles -- until Audrey's ex-boyfriend suddenly shows up with a team of deadly assassins on his trail. Unexpectedly thrust into an international conspiracy, the gals soon find themselves dodging killers and a suspicious British agent while hatching a plan to save the world.

programme.title: Red
programme.desc: After surviving an assault from a squad of hit men, retired CIA agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) reassembles his old team for an all-out war. Frank reunites with old Joe (Morgan Freeman), crazy Marvin (John Malkovich) and wily Victoria (Helen Mirren) to uncover a massive conspiracy that threatens their lives. Only their expert training will allow them to survive a near-impossible mission -- breaking into CIA headquarters.

programme.desc: A police rookie (Jamie Lee Curtis) loses her badge, gains a boyfriend (Ron Silver) and hunts a killer who uses a .44-caliber Magnum.

programme.title: Evil Under the Sun
programme.desc: Agatha Christie's Belgian sleuth, Hercule Poirot (Peter Ustinov), solves the murder of an actress at a Balkan resort.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: An educational trip turns into a Decepticon hunt as Bee and the Bots stumble upon the shape-shifter PSEUDO in a western ghost town.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: As Optimus prepares to return to Earth to face the mysterious Great Evil he's prophesied to Bumblebee, the Bee Team tries to prevent Steeljaw's Pack from teleporting that very threat, the First Decepticon, MEGATRONUS, back into Earth's dimension.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: The Autobots split into two teams, one facing an old foe of Bumblebee's and the other a Decepticon in the polar wastes.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: With an old score to settle, Bumblebee insists on taking on OVERLOAD alone, while weakened Optimus must learn to contribute in ways other than combat if his team is to bring down POLARCLAW.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: As Steeljaw learns of a community of Decepticons in a surprising location, Grimlock and Strongarm struggle to improve their teamwork as, together with Bumblebee, they face SABERHORN.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: After a mistake in the field, Strongarm takes herself out of action just when the team needs her most against fire-­‐starting Decepticons CRAZYBOLT and SLICEDICE.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Windblade's concern for Optimus' well-­‐being may spell doom for the entire Away Team when they run up against a sly hunter of a Decepticon named RAZORPAW.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Grimlock forgets how to fight when, in an effort to become smarter, he downloads a huge amount of data into his brain and overwrites his combat instincts.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: More hints about Decepticon Island are revealed when Steeljaw invades the Scrapyard with a clever plan, and Bumblebee, Grimlock and Strongarm confront SCORPONOK, one of the Island's leaders.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: After being coaxed into going to a concert given by his favorite band, Bumblebee hopes for a quiet evening away from the Scrapyard, but finds action and danger when BISK attacks the arena.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Grimlock's quest for an effective disguise goes into overdrive when QUILLFIRE returns and Bumblebee and Strongarm find themselves stuck in an impound lot.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Fixit's efforts to repair the GroundBridge go horribly awry, instead summoning two of the most legendary and fearsome Decepticons to the Scrapyard – and banishing Bumblebee to another dimension.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Trying to show how effective they are without their teacher's direction, Slipstorm and Jetstorm inadevertently put Drift in harm's way and must come to their master's aid before he is destroyed by STOCKADE.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: With the Bee Team and the Away Team reunited, the Autobots, joined by an old friend, locate and investigate Decepticon Island, and unexpectedly find Steeljaw in charge of an army of Decepticons!

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Badly outnumbered and trapped on Decepticon Island, the Autobots desperately search for a way to take out Steeljaw and put his army of fugitives in stasis, but friction between Bumblebee and Optimus could put the mission – and all of Earth – at risk!

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Bumblebee's guided tour of Earth brings the Bee Team to Optimus Prime's old base, but Sideswipe doesn't have any use for history.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: When Strongarm surprisingly scores the lowest on a skills test created by Fixit, she's determined to improve her score.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Not wanting the over-­‐aggressive Dinobot to compromise his team's quest to capture the scavenger Decepticons and their Mini-­‐Cons, Bee sends Grimlock on a "solo mission" to the Alps.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: The Scavengers find a most unexpected relic, even as their mysterious Mini-­‐Cons make their escape and their even more unexpected pursuer, Starscream, arrives on Earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Starscream gloats over his impending victory, unaware that Optimus Prime has arrived to help the remaining Autobots. After being surprised by, and taken over by, the Mini-­‐Cons, the heroes ally with the Mini-­‐Cons, who share their secrets with the team.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Starscream tries to absorb the power of six of the Mini-­‐Cons, but needs the seventh to obtain the ultimate power he craves for his revenge.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Overconfidence leaves the Bee Team unprepared when they face a Stunticon that can fire guided missiles...on the desert ground above a nuclear waste disposal site!

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Bumblebee struggles to bring his out-of-practice team to combat readiness as they square off against the missiles and oil barrel traps of Stunticon Heatseeker.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Grimlock begs to learn new fighting methods from reluctant "teacher" Drift –but Grimlock's initial attempts to put Drift's lessons into action fall comically flat.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: While recovering one of Windblade's hidden caches, the Autobots run into Rescue Bot Blurr.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: The Bee Team captures a Skunkticonwho's obsessively guarding a strange Sphere-shaped artifact. The curious Sphere bears a more than passing resemblance to a mythical relic that can reveal the location of the lost city of Doradus.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: BLURR continues on as SIDESWIPE's intern while BUMBLEBEE discovers a replacement Decepticon Hunter exists in Windblade's hidden cache on the island town of WEST ROCK CITY. Unfortunately, Stunticons DRAG STRIP and WILDCHASE find the cache first.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: When Stunticon Drag Strip steals a powerful Cybertronian artifact known as a Gravitic Adjuster, the Bee Team gives chase but arecaught in an explosion that once again fuses them into the Ultra Bee Team Combiner (UBTC).

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: A string of mysterious explosives thefts leave the Bee Team flummoxed, but Strongarm is convinced that there's a criminal mastermind at work.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: DRIFT's former mentor SHADOW RAKER ,a Fagin-like thief, has come to Earth to reclaim what he believes to be rightfully his — JETSTORM and SLIPSTREAM!

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: After Fixit's latest attempt at combining the team, the Autobots ends up swapping bodies! They then discover that the Stunticons have entered the local Grand Prix assuming that whomever winswillbe crowned the literal "ruler of the roads."

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Strongarm's best friend from her time at the Police Academy, Chicane, shows up at the Scrapyard.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: When Fixit discovers an ancient Cybertronian signal originating on an island off the coast of England, he begs Bumblebee to tag along on the investigation.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: When FIXIT attempts to sample GRIMLOCK's DNA for a bot-combiner experiment, his Particle Sampler instead invests the once-slow Dinobot with dangerous superspeed!

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: In his haste to polish Drift's Katana, Slipstream accidentally uses an acid that wrecks it. Before he can make repairs, the Bee Team races off to stop the Stunticons from stealing a high-tech train's engine.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: Bee insists his teambegin to follow his orders more rigorously, but this new micromanaging strategy shows cracks when Motormaster attacks a Meteor Deflector facility.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: The Bee Team is about to embark on a mission to the moon to retrieve the last remaining cache item, when Optimus Prime arrives to recruit Drift for a special assignment.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: The Autobots are attacked by Steeljaw and his pack and driven from the Scrapyard. In the process, Sideswipe is nearly left behind, drudging up bad memories of his days alone on Cybertron.

programme.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise
programme.desc: With quarters cramped in the cavern, Bumblebee and Fixit scout for a new living arrangement. Sideswipe and Strongarm venture out as well, and are trapped by Clampdown inside a shipping container.

programme.title: D.W. and the Beastly Birthday
programme.desc: Time to put on your party hats and dancing shoes – D.W. is turning five! When her birthday doesn’t go as planned, D.W. runs away to the magical island of Ukubonga. This is one party you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Arthur: Summer Stories
programme.desc: It’s time to celebrate summer! Join Arthur as he takes a family vacation and visits Grandpa Dave’s farm. Then, Arthur, D.W. and Buster spend a few days at the beach where they discover the simple joys of building sandcastles!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: For some reason, Arthur isn't doing very well in school anymore. Maybe he just needs some glasses? Problem is, Arthur hates having to wear them. And it's school picture day and Muffy is determined that Francine will look her best.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Eyes / Francine's Bad Hair Day

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's the first day of third grade and Arthur's biggest fear has come true--his new teacher is the dreaded Mr. Ratburn. Then, it’s time for the all-school spellathon. Arthur is chosen to compete, and he finds facing Prunella and The Brain!
programme.sub-title: Arthur and The Real Mr. Ratburn/Arthur's Spelling Trubble

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Reads are having a wonderful time at the beach, except for D.W. who simply refuses to have fun. Next, Buster and Arthur make a long-awaited field trip to a dinosaur excavation.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Someone only D.W. can see has moved in with the Reads. Her name is Nadine, and she follows D.W. everywhere. Arthur is the first to get the new Scare-Your-Pants-Off book from the library. Unfortunately, he can't figure out where he put it!
programme.sub-title: D.W.'S Imaginary Friend/Arthur's Lost Library Book

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: How can Arthur prove to his parents that he's responsible enough to take care of his very own puppy? "Get a job," suggests D.W.!. Yet another personality change for D.W., who's decided that from now on, she'll be just like Arthur.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and Francine are fighting. But when they get locked inside the library they either have to make up or prepare for a long evening. And when Buster opens his detective agency, he has no idea his first job will involve Arthur.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and his friends go to summer camp where it's strictly boys vs. girls. Next, Buster Baxter is everyone's favorite jokester. Unfortunately, though, Buster's grades aren't as good as his jokes, and Buster may have to repeat third grade.
programme.sub-title: Arthur Goes To Camp/Buster Makes The Grade

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's new puppy is exactly what he wanted. He's cute and wriggly, and he follows Arthur everywhere. But training a puppy is harder than Arthur thought. Then, a mere $10 stands between Arthur and the shoes he's been dreaming about.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: You think running a marathon is hard? Try babysitting for the Terrible Tibble Twins. Next, Arthur's family is hosting the once-a-year-is-more-than-enough family reunion. But a major thunderstorm turns this into a reunion to remember.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Only four more days until Arthur's birthday party! But to Arthur's horror, it turns out Muffy's having her birthday party on the very same day. And, now that Francine finally has the lead in a school play, she's has become a stage tyrant.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur is not too sure he's ready for a new baby in the house. What do babies do besides cry? Then, living with a baby is no picnic. Just how long will Baby Kate be hanging around, anyway? And who would even miss D.W. if she ran away?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Struggling with a school assignment, Arthur decides that his regular life is just too boring to write about. And, Arthur is the only one who believes in the superior intelligence of his dog. But even Arthur gets confused when Pal runs away.
programme.sub-title: Arthur Writes A Story/Arthur's Lost Dog

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W.'s beloved bird gets very sick, and despite D.W.'s eager ministrations, Spanky dies. Can she risk giving her heart to another pet? Then, Buster doesn't have time for Arthur. And all he wants to talk about is a new friend named Mike.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur always seems to wreck things, and this time it's Mom's computer. Can he get it fixed before Mom finds out? Then, Muffy A. Crosswire and Francine are absolute best friends, despite their rather obvious differences.
programme.sub-title: Arthur The Wrecker/Arthur and The True Francine

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What's got moldy bathrooms, lumpy beds and lots of rain? Arthur's family vacation. Then, Arthur and D.W. go to visit their grandfather, but the visit doesn't turn out as expected, because Grandpa Dave isn't your usual kind of grandfather.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Family Vacation/Grandpa Dave's Old Country Farm

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A year's supply of Crunch Cereal is in store for the person who can write the new Crunch Cereal jingle, and Arthur is sure he can do it. Next, how hard can it be to do a cartwheel on a balance beam? D.W. is about to find out.
programme.sub-title: Arthur and The Crunch Cereal Contest/D.W. Flips

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy bets Francine she can't be nice to everyone for a whole week--and soon wishes she hadn't. Next, Arthur didn't mean to tell a lie, he just got stuck in a sort of fib, because he thought it was cool to be a Gleeper.
programme.sub-title: Meek For A Week/Arthur, World's Greatest Gleeper

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The circus is in town and the whole family's excited—until Arthur gets CHICKEN POX! Will he recover in time? Then, Arthur's worst fears come true when poor, sick Pal has to sleep overnight at the vet's office. Could it be something he did?
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Chicken Pox/Sick As A Dog

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: In D.W.’s heart lurks one big, gnawing desire--TO GET RID OF THOSE TRAINING WHEELS! Then, can Coach Frensky work with a baseball team where everyone is fighting about who gets to be pitcher and no one wants to practice?
programme.sub-title: D.W. Rides Again/Arthur Makes The Team

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's raining and boy is it BORING! But then, in Grandma Thora's attic, Arthur and D.W. discover some really FASCINATING stuff about their parents. Next, Grandma Thora is helping to organize a bake sale, but her goodies aren’t very good.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Almost Boring Day/The Half-Baked Sale

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A new girl has arrived in town and no one knows anything about her. And judging by the strange things happening at her house no one wants to know. Then, it's great having a friend spend the weekend.
programme.sub-title: Sue Ellen Moves In/The Perfect Brother

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. saves everything. But her most prized possession is a snowball from last winter. But now it’s disappeared! Then, Arthur, Francine, and Buster must do a report on ancient Rome--but can they work as a team to complete the assignment?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Is Binky Barnes really the most disgusting, nasty, horrible person on the planet, or is he just misunderstood? Next, what's got four sides and the answer to everything? Prunella's cootie catcher!

programme.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled
programme.desc: The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man's suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron's control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN! The Avengers prepare for a party with a surprise guest when Ultron crashes the preparations by using mind control on Iron Man. While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron's plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off! Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers' Tower. Ultron's ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they've stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it's on! It's a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?

programme.title: The Book Of Obsession
programme.desc: The Knights are tasked with protecting the King's valuable Ned Knights comic book during the Bookingheim Knight-a-Con. But with all the costumed kids there, will they recognize the real Jestro and Book of Monsters coming to get them? King Halbert instructs the Knights that they must take his valuable Ned Knights comic book to the “Knight-a-Kon” in Bookingham. It will be the first be first prize at the Knight-a-Kon. But the Book of Monsters wants the book, too. Having devoured Ned Knightly comic books in it's down time it has become fanatically obsessed with the storyline. General Magmar suggests they simply attack the place and take what they want, but Jestro tells them they can't: everyone will be in costume and they'll be thousands of comics there. This calls for a clever “infiltration” mission (which will also allow Jestro to see the Kon, which he's always wanted to do.) So Jestro goes into the Kon with the BOM and some monsters. And it's easy because everyone is in costume Jestro, the BOM and their monsters fit right in at the convention and Clay and crew have their work cut out for them trying to separate fiend from fan. Macy keeps going on-and-on about the story in the King's comic book as the Knights keep a watchful eye on it. Robin even shows up in the “Minitrex” – a small version of the Fortrex he built just for the Knight-a-Kon. He's convinced he can win the costume competition that is the big closing event for the Kon. At the end of the Kon there's a big awards ceremony for “Best Costume.” The prize: “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1.” The BOM must get it and scheme to get closer to it during the costume contest. He's just…about…to get the book when…the impatient Magmar attacks! Everyone thinks it's part of the big show! “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1” is tossed from person-to-person-to-person in the melee. The Knights must do something, but they're too far away from the Fortrex to download any NEXO-Power. Robin pulls up in his Minitrex they can use it to get NEXO-Power! Robin wins the best costume for his Minitrex and wins the Ned Knightly Comic which he then gives to Macy…she deserves to read it.

programme.title: A Star is Fashioned

She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores—everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy. During Raspberry's preliminary trip to the city to begin arrangements for her new design studio, her friends get a taste of life without her. They miss her, and it makes them sad. Cherry admits to Strawberry that she's concerned for Raspberry—stardom is not all it's cracked up to be. We see that Cherry was worried about her friend, not jealous. Raspberry returns to pack up her little boutique. Her friends barely recognize her.

programme.title: Blippi's Alphabet and Transportation Adventures

From solving puzzles and meeting farm animals to discovering vintage buses and historic airplanes, Blippi makes learning an adventure filled with curiosity and fun.

programme.title: Blippi's Fun and Colorful Exploration

Each adventure is packed with laughter, creativity, and educational moments, making learning a joyful experience for kids.

Soon Orange's store is overflowing with Berry Bitty Fruits & Veggies. It's the berry first time Orange has not been able to find a “place for everything” in her store.

programme.title: Room at the Top
